name: impeccable
description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
one_liner: A set of 24 plain-English commands (like 'polish', 'audit', 'critique') that let you steer an AI coding tool's design decisions the way you'd direct a human designer.
buyer: An indie developer or small agency shipping client apps who needs a consistent, non-generic design process but can't justify hiring a full-time designer.
business_use_cases: A solo developer runs `/impeccable audit` and `/impeccable polish` before every client handoff to catch and fix generic 'AI-made' design tells.
An agency standardizes their design review step on these commands so junior staff can produce senior-level polish without a dedicated designer on every project.
A freelancer sells a one-time 'design critique and fix' pass on an existing AI-built product using the tool's structured audit output as the deliverable report.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'ship-ready polish pass' service for founders who built their MVP with AI tools and know it needs a design cleanup.
Package a PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md starter template for a specific vertical (e.g. local services) and sell it to agencies serving that niche.

steal_this: Run `/impeccable audit` on your own last AI-built side project this weekend, fix what it flags, and use the before/after as a portfolio piece to sell polish passes to others.
